name: paypal-mcp
description: PayPal Model Context Protocol server providing access to PayPal services and operations for AI assistants

auth.description: Requires PayPal OAuth Bearer token in Authorization header

documentation.readme: PayPal MCP Server provides AI assistants with secure access to PayPal's payment processing, transaction management, and compliance services through the Model Context Protocol.
documentation.setup:
1. Obtain PayPal OAuth credentials
2. Configure Bearer token authentication
3. Connect to https://mcp.paypal.com/sse using SSE transport
4. Use SSL certificate bundle for PayPal's internal PKI
